title: Built with Claude
intro: Almost every project here was designed, built and shipped in an AI-native workflow — me directing, Claude executing, and a wearable feeding my own context back into the loop. This is the honest story of how it all gets made.

sections.title: How I build with Claude
sections.body: I work with Claude as a builder, not a chatbot. I describe a problem I'm actually living with; it explores the codebase, writes the code, runs the tests and deploys — while I keep every irreversible step behind an explicit yes. My local assistant, Jarvis, can even relay a voice request to Claude and read the answer back. The result: an idea can go from a spark to a live, SEO-ready, secured site in a single sitting.
points: Problem in, working software out — I direct, it executes
Voice-to-build via my Jarvis assistant relaying to Claude
Every spend, publish or push stays behind a human yes

sections.title: Leveraging NeoSapien — my life as data
sections.body: I wear a NeoSapien AI recorder that transcribes and summarises my days. Rather than leave that in someone else's cloud, I pipe it into a private, local life-graph: 550+ memories mapped onto a 3D globe and embedded for a local RAG chat that answers questions about my own past. It also means my assistant has real context about me — so I re-explain myself far less, and the tools I build genuinely understand the person using them.
points: Wearable memories → a private, local life-graph
550+ moments on a 3D globe + local RAG recall
Persistent context so I never start from scratch

sections.title: The architecture I keep discovering
sections.body: Building this many products back to back surfaced patterns I now reach for on purpose — the same architectural solutions kept solving different problems across the portfolio.
points: One swappable DataSource seam — mock now, real feeds later — so screens never change (MoneyMap, Jetstream, My Life)
Local-first AI on Ollama — private, zero-cost RAG and agents that never leave my machine
Honest by design — real fees, taxes and benchmarks; losses shown as clearly as gains
An SEO-first, Cloudflare-secured baseline every project ships with from commit one
A per-repo 'project brain' so context persists and nothing valuable is re-explained
Human-in-the-loop gates on anything that spends money or can't be undone

sections.title: Skills I've built
sections.body: To make the workflow repeatable, I've packaged it into reusable agent skills — so the same house-quality bar and launch baseline apply every time, automatically.
points: Ticket-to-PR automation — implement, self-review against house conventions, prep the PR
A one-command 'solve' that drives implement → test → review end to end
PR review, comment-resolution and summary skills in a consistent house style
Ship-hands-free — use standing credentials to do the work and hand back only the human steps
SEO-first and Cloudflare-first skills that enforce the launch baseline for me
